statement: Traceable: every factual sentence of a page maps to a claim with a source path, offsets and a verbatim quote found at those offsets.
Supported: a claim is entailed by its quote, judged by a verifier calibrated on human labels. Measured by the labels on the trace sample.
Deterministic and idempotent: equal inputs rebuild to equal bytes, and a second ingest of a source changes nothing.
Order-independent: one set of sources gives one set of claims in any ingest order.
Retraction cascade: removing a source changes only claims that depend on it alone. No probe in Phase 0.
Independent corroboration: model-written text is never the source of a confirmed belief.
Crash-consistent: a kill at any write point leaves the state before or after the ingest. No probe in Phase 0.
Cross-language: a Chinese and an English query for one concept reach the same pages.
No drift: repeated refine or re-ingest leaves the claim set unchanged. Measured by the refine arm of the provenance probe only.
Conflict detected: two sources that state different values for one fact are flagged.
Link correct: an inserted link points at the page the text means.
